Vejle Sygehus is a hospital located in the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) [^src1]. It plays a specific role in national healthcare quality monitoring by reporting data used in supplementary analyses of cancer diseases among acute surgical patients [^src1]. 

This data contribution is featured in the 2024 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen, or AKDB), which examines patient composition and the distribution of cancer diagnoses among operated patients between September 1, 2022, and August 31, 2023 [^src1]. The hospital's reporting feeds into a broader quality development initiative led by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram) [^src1]. Specifically, the detailed, hospital-level distribution of cancer diagnoses provided by Vejle Sygehus serves as critical background for assessing "indicator 11" (90-day mortality) [^src1]. Because comorbidities such as cancer are known predictors of postoperative outcomes, this data is essential for adjusting quality measures and performing risk adjustment on these clinical indicators [^src1].
